name: TT's Turkey Chili
author: Ty Phelps
steps: Dice all the vegetables (red bell pepper, celery, and onion).
In a large pot, brown the ground turkey with the diced onion until the meat is fully cooked.
Add the diced celery and red bell pepper to the pot, and cook until they begin to soften.
Stir in the oregano, onion powder, chili powder and remaining seasoning
Drain the beans and add the to the pot.
Pour in the bone broth (use more than 2 cups if needed), and add the two bay leaves.
Add a spoonful of tomato paste and stir well to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and let the chili simmer for about 25 minutes, stirring frequently. Chili should be thick but also a little liquified but not soupy.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
